title: Engineering Q&A — The Equipment Share of a Baseline Reset, Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions
content:
# The Equipment Share of a Baseline Reset

Questions answered on the share of a building's measured use the new plant is taken to account for when the baseline of a subscription under Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions is restated. The cooling plant share is 46 percent, the heating and air side share 31 percent, and the whole of the measured basis 100 percent.

## Rule

Where the closed project replaced a chiller, a cooling tower or a central plant, the equipment share is the cooling plant share. Where the closed project replaced a boiler or rebuilt an air handler, the equipment share is the heating and air side share. In every other case the equipment share is the whole of the measured basis.

## Questions

**Where is the scope read from?** From the company's records of the closed project at that building under Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects: the scope recorded against the project standing closed.

**A closed chiller replacement.** The cooling plant share, 46 percent. A cooling tower replacement or a central plant rebuild, the same 46 percent.

**A closed boiler replacement.** The heating and air side share, 31 percent. An air handler rebuild, the same 31 percent.

**A closed project of some other scope, or no closed project at the building.** The whole of the measured basis, 100 percent.

## Summary

| Scope of the closed project | Equipment share |
|---|---|
| chiller replacement, cooling tower replacement, central plant rebuild | 46 percent |
| boiler replacement, air handler rebuild | 31 percent |
| any other scope, or none on record | 100 percent |
